method: Deterministic transfer of existing corrected common aircraft, tight union of old and new aircraft including rotor/tail plus immediate shadow; feather exterior only

visualReview.aircraft: Orange fuselage; black engine housing and tail boom; white-orange bands; white body graphic; circular cabin windows; no lettering, registration, flag or logo observed. Five main rotor blades visible.
visualReview.preserved: All vehicles, people, buildings, water, trees, cones and windsock outside aircraft/shadow union remain original.
visualReview.limitation: Local background exposed by removal of original rotor is taken from corrected crop inside union mask; no full-scene regeneration. Runtime and stakeholder acceptance not claimed.
